DECISION (Brandon, 2026-10-23): a missed window leaves the scene open. The player recovers through a package-declared recovery storylet. The recovery REUSES an existing outcome (A or B) at a HIGHER cost. There is NO third outcome, so the outcome count and downstream variants are unchanged, and the scene completes through the existing successor transition with no min_turns floor, exactly like a normally earned outcome.

GOAL (step 5b):
(A) Model: add a REQUIRED field recovery_storylet_id to Incident (storylet id pattern as IncidentOutcome.storylet_id uses). Because it is required, update every incidents.yaml in the repo and tests that builds an Incident (grep for incidents.yaml and Incident( under tests/ and data/; data/ currently declares no incidents, confirm and say so).
(B) Loader (StoryPackageError naming the incident id) rejects: unknown recovery storylet; recovery storylet in a different scene than the incident; recovery storylet equal to the outcomes' shared storylet; a recovery storylet none of whose realizations qualifies. A realization QUALIFIES when it asserts true every advantage of exactly one existing outcome AND every cost of that outcome AND at least one extra declared fact that is not any outcome's advantage or cost (the recovery cost). Also reject a recovery storylet whose activation does not require the missed-window event's own fact(s) to be true, so the recovery is unavailable before the window is missed (read how activation conditions are expressed and use the existing mechanism). The message must say which rule failed.
(C) Engine behaviour, proven by tests on the fixture; change the engine only if a test shows it is needed: (1) before the window fires, the recovery storylet is not eligible; (2) after the window fires, a player command that earns the recovery realization asserts the reused outcome's advantages, its own costs and the recovery cost, resolved_incident_outcome returns that existing outcome, and the player enters the successor scene on that same turn without the min_turns floor; (3) once the recovery fires the normal outcome storylet cannot also fire, and once a normal outcome fires the recovery cannot (check explain_reveal both ways and say in the notes if exclusivity is one-sided as step 1 found); (4) the recovery cost fact is NOT asserted by a normally earned outcome; (5) the missed window itself still grants nothing and the scene still does not leave without a recovery or an outcome (step 4 behaviour unchanged); (6) save then restore after recovery keeps facts and does not re-fire it.
(D) Fixture: extend tests/fixtures/stories/lighthouse-incident with the recovery storylet (use a valid SL-1A-<letter> id), its realization, a declared recovery-cost fact, the knowledge entry that realizes it (follow the shape of the existing outcome knowledge entries), the activation requiring tide_has_turned, and recovery_storylet_id in incidents.yaml. All existing tests must keep passing; the step 4 pressure tests that earn an outcome after the window must still pass.

TESTS in tests/test_incident_recovery.py plus loader rejection tests (one per rule in (B)) in tests/test_incident_loader.py built from a copy of the fixture in tmp_path. Deterministic, no live worker, no billed model, each under a second. Never use xfail or skip to hide a failure.

HOW TO RUN: first confirm PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -c "import storygame; print(storygame.__file__)" prints a path inside the cwd. Tests: PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov tests/test_incident_recovery.py tests/test_incident_pressure.py tests/test_incident_engine.py tests/test_incident_loader.py tests/test_incident_characterization.py tests/test_traversal.py. Then the FULL suite: PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov -n auto (bare pytest, NOT with '.'). Ruff: PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix <your files>, then -m ruff format <your files>. Do not run uv.

NOTES CONTRACT: step5b-notes.md: one line per lettered item (A)-(D) with file:line, one line per behaviour (1)-(6) in (C) with what the test pinned and whether the engine needed a change, any existing test you edited and why, then one line saying what step 6 must declare for 1C (storylet id, realization, recovery cost fact). Reply with a short summary.
